profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer | New York Times & Hearst alum

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Collaborated with a cross-functional team to design and implement A/B testing strategies for optimizing user engagement and monetization on NYT Games (e.g., Wordle, Spelling Bee, The Crossword), resulting in significant increases in registration and subscription rates

• Spearheaded the initiative to adopt Tailwind CSS, demonstrating its performance benefits and rapid prototyping capabilities

• Integrated design system tokens into the Tailwind CSS configuration, establishing it as the source of truth for dynamic design system documentation

• Led high stakes refactors to improve Games web architecture and expedite onboarding for external collaborators

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Ideated and prototyped browser-based game concepts using Vanilla JS, HTML Canvas, and CSS animations, integrated analytics to provide insights for game development opportunities

• Productionised game prototypes by converting Vanilla JS to React, integrating shared components, persisting game progress to backends, adding state management and performance optimizations, and establishing editor tools and publishing pipelines

positions.title: Product Designer
positions.description:
• Specialized in writing modular, reusable code to implement styleguides at scale across over 20 brands in the Hearst Magazines digital portfolio

• Created user flows, defined interaction and motion using Sass/CSS, HTML/Twig, JavaScript and Sketch.

• Designed and developed ad-hoc tools for streamlining and automating team workflow using ES6 and Node.js.

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
• Responsible for all aspects of design and front-end development, including creating wireframes, designing mockups, converting PSD’s to responsive HTML and CSS, and adding interactivity with React and UI component libraries.

• Increased social media following by 500% in less than three months.

• Collected over 300,000 consumer data points to inform marketing strategies for partner haircare, skincare and cosmetics companies.

• Developed and implemented strategies for customer acquisition, customer retention, expansion of brand partnerships, inventory management, and subscription shipping.

positions.title: Intern, Office of International Religious Freedom, Near Eastern Affairs
positions.description:
The Office of International Religious Freedom has the mission of promoting religious freedom as a core objective of U.S. foreign policy. The office is headed by Ambassador-at-Large for International Religious Freedom Suzan Johnson Cook. We monitor religious persecution and discrimination worldwide, recommend and implement policies in respective regions or countries, and develop programs to promote religious freedom.

• Edited and proofread over 20 country reports for the 2010 Annual Report to Congress on International Religious Freedom, provided event and administrative support, escorted visitors.
• Conducted research for regional officers, drafted briefing papers on asylum cases for religious minorities and collected data at forums and events.

positions.title: Office Assistant
positions.description:
• Organized and maintained a comprehensive database of electronic client records. 
• Executed weekly direct mailing campaigns to over 20,000 recipients.

positions.title: Intern, Central Florida Freedom School
positions.description:
The CDF Freedom Schools program provides summer and after-school enrichment that helps children fall in love with reading, increases their self-esteem, and generates more positive attitudes toward learning. Children are taught using a model curriculum that supports children and families around five essential components: high quality academic enrichment; parent and family involvement; civic engagement and social action; intergenerational leadership development; and nutrition, health and mental health.

• Instructed a class of 5-8 year olds in a summer reading program. Developed and implemented culturally relevant lesson plans and established strategies for classroom management.
• Assisted with fundraising, event planning, community outreach, site development and field trip coordination.

positions.title: Cataloging Assistant, Middle Eastern Approvals Section
positions.description:
• Utilized Arabic language proficiency to arrange and organize incoming shipments of Arabic/Persian media. 
• Added components in Arabic script to the Voyager cataloging system.
